clue.text: Flower getting prize at the dairy show?

definitions.meaning: whimsically, a trophy for the best dairy produce, a cup for butter

explanation.surface: A flower wins a trophy at an agricultural dairy show.
explanation.definitionFit: The yellow meadow bloom is named as though it were a trophy awarded for the best spread at a show.

clue.text: Make use of a new suite 51

indicators.note: new signals that the letters are made into a fresh arrangement

parts.note: 51 in Roman numerals is LI

explanation.surface: Someone puts a brand-new hotel suite numbered 51 to use.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' rearranges SUITE together with LI, the Roman numerals for 51.
explanation.definitionFit: To employ something is to put it to use.

clue.text: In that neither will change

indicators.note: will change says the letters of the preceding word are to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A remark that neither party in some situation is going to alter.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal adverb meaning in that place or matter.

clue.text: After-effects of the battle

parts.note: re means concerning, about, so of in the sense 'on the subject of'
an action is a military engagement

explanation.surface: The aftermath following a battle.
explanation.definitionFit: A response that follows some event is its consequence or after-effect.

clue.text: Becoming a supporter hesitantly

parts.note: a prop is something that supports
er is the sound of someone hesitating

explanation.surface: Someone seems to be agreeing to back a cause, but without conviction.
explanation.definitionFit: Becoming in the sense of fitting or seemly, as correct behaviour is.

clue.text: Turned up in France

parts.note: the French phrase for turned up, used in English of a snub nose

explanation.surface: Something arrived unexpectedly while in France.
explanation.walkthrough: The French word is used in English for a nose that tilts upward at the tip.
explanation.definitionFit: Borrowed from French, this past participle describes a tip-tilted nose.

clue.text: Nutty-sounding officer

indicators.note: sounding says the word is identified by how it is spoken rather than spelt

parts.note: a kernel is the edible inside of a nut

explanation.surface: An army officer who sounds slightly mad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sounding' signals a homophone: KERNEL, the inner part of a nut, is said the same way as the military rank.
explanation.definitionFit: A senior army rank is a kind of officer.

clue.text: Present politician with some money

parts.note: to present is to offer
a Tory is a member of the UK Conservative Party

explanation.surface: Someone hands a politician a little cash.
explanation.walkthrough: The collection taken during a church service is this.
explanation.definitionFit: Money gathered from a congregation during the service is the collection, so some money.

clue.text: Recite without pausing that the dance has been cancelled

parts.note: a reel is a lively Scottish dance
an event that is off has been called off

explanation.surface: Someone announces in one breath that the dance has been called off.
explanation.definitionFit: To rattle something off fluently and quickly is to say it without stopping.

clue.text: Sack one who goes to blazes

parts.note: to sack someone is to fire them
man as in a person, one individual

explanation.surface: A demand to dismiss somebody who has gone to blazes.
explanation.definitionFit: A person in a fire brigade goes to fires, the blazes of the clue.

clue.text: Aim to find postal order in money bag

indicators.note: in says one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: a purse is a small bag for money
PO is the abbreviation for postal order, a British money order bought at a post office

explanation.surface: Someone aims to find a postal order inside a money bag.
explanation.definitionFit: An aim is an intention or goal.

clue.text: A very important event by the way

definitions.meaning: a significant stage or landmark in a life or project
a stone marker at the roadside giving distances

explanation.surface: A remark mentioning, as an aside, some momentous occasion.
explanation.definitionFit: Both a turning point in history and a roadside marker showing distances.

clue.text: Hurried up with speed to give an account

indicators.note: in a down clue, up says the word is read from bottom to top, backwards

parts.note: hurried means ran
rate is speed, as in a rate of knots

explanation.surface: Someone rushed up quickly in order to make a report.
explanation.definitionFit: To recount a story is to tell it.

clue.text: One will never agree to have one

definitions.text: One will never agree to have one

parts.words: One will never agree to have one
parts.note: a quarrel needs people who will not agree

explanation.surface: A riddle about something you get only by disagreeing.
explanation.definitionFit: A quarrel is a disagreement, so people who never agree end up having one.

clue.text: Sign a book in the shed

indicators.note: in says these pieces are put inside another

parts.note: Leo is a sign of the zodiac
NT is the New Testament, a book of the Bible

explanation.surface: Someone autographs a volume while sitting in the garden shed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sign' looks like a verb (autograph) but is a zodiac sign; 'in' is the container signal, and 'book' is the usual crossword shorthand for a Testament.
explanation.definitionFit: A simple shed built against a wall, leaning on it for support.

clue.text: Disembark on coast for an overwhelming victory

parts.note: to land is to come ashore
to coast is to slide along without effort

explanation.surface: Troops come ashore on the coast and win easily.
explanation.definitionFit: A huge electoral win is likened to a mass of earth sweeping down a hill.

clue.text: Board accept new role that can be endured

indicators.note: accept says the board takes the other letters inside it

parts.note: a table is a board, as in board and lodging

indicators.note: new says the letters are put into a fresh order

explanation.surface: The board agrees to give someone a new role they can put up with.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Board' reads as a committee, but it is a piece of furniture; 'new' is the anagram signal on 'role', and 'accept' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Something bearable can be put up with.

clue.text: Difficult person turning sour

parts.note: one is an individual person

indicators.note: turning says the letters are twisted into another order

explanation.surface: An awkward person whose mood is turning sour.
explanation.definitionFit: A burdensome task is hard and demanding.

clue.text: Not skilled poetically?

parts.note: lacking experience, read playfully as having no lines of poetry

explanation.surface: Someone with no talent for writing poetry.
explanation.definitionFit: Inexperienced, read whimsically as having no verse in one.

clue.text: Making a sound come back

parts.note: a noise rebounding off a surface

explanation.surface: Producing a noise that returns.
explanation.definitionFit: Reverberating, as a shout does in a canyon, sends the noise back.

clue.text: Approximately but rather less closely

definitions.meaning: almost, but a bit short of exactly

explanation.surface: A comment comparing a rough estimate with one a bit off the mark.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are almost: roughly, and falling just short of the exact mark.

clue.text: Girl is able to turn over the calendar

parts.note: Alma is a girl's name

indicators.note: to turn over says the word is flipped round and read backwards

parts.note: can means is able

explanation.surface: A girl manages to flip over the page of a calendar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to turn over' makes CAN into NAC.
explanation.definitionFit: A yearly publication listing dates and events, a kind of calendar.

clue.text: Leonard, I and ten others are tolerant

parts.note: Len is short for Leonard

indicators.note: others says the letters are made into another word

explanation.surface: Leonard, the speaker and ten more people are all easy-going.
explanation.definitionFit: Merciful or forgiving, so tolerant of faults.

clue.text: Last month salesman had art, isle that was worn out

annotationWithheld.why: Clue held as 'Last month salesman had art, isle that was worn out': DEC + REP give DECREP, but 'had art, isle' is OCR garble with no clear way to IT, and no scan to check.
annotationWithheld.clue: Last month salesman had art, isle that was worn out

clue.text: Where these dealers may end up?

definitions.text: Where these dealers may end up?

parts.words: Where these dealers may end up?
parts.note: traders who use secret information may go to prison, slang for which is the answer

explanation.surface: A question about where certain traders finish.
explanation.walkthrough: Insider dealers, who trade on confidential information, may end up in prison; British slang says such a prisoner is 'in' it.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang for in prison, where those who trade on secret knowledge may land.

clue.text: Do not baby-sit at any time, it does not matter

definitions.text: Do not baby-sit at any time

definitions.meaning: a phrase dismissing something as unimportant

explanation.surface: An instruction to stop child-minding, with a shrug that it is unimportant.
explanation.definitionFit: Read literally, never watch over the child; idiomatically, forget it, no importance.

clue.text: Fool has designed these for the bath!

indicators.note: designed says the letters are arranged into a new pattern

explanation.surface: A silly person has created some bath-time items.
explanation.definitionFit: Dried gourd sponges used for scrubbing in a bath.

clue.text: To the same extent liable to be in pieces

parts.note: as means to the same degree, as in as big as
under means subject or liable to, as in under threat

explanation.surface: Something equally likely to break into bits.
explanation.definitionFit: Torn apart means broken into fragments.

clue.text: Very many who went fishing held out bait temptingly

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for 500, a large number
angled means fished with rod and line

explanation.surface: Lots of anglers offered tempting bait.
explanation.definitionFit: Hanging a lure before a fish, or an offer before a person, to entice them.

clue.text: Destroy completely-I'd create a replacement

indicators.note: replacement says the letters are put back in new positions

explanation.surface: Someone vows to wipe something out and build a substitute.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a replacement' rearranges I'D CREATE plus A.
explanation.definitionFit: To wipe out entirely, root and branch.
